subject: Pipeline step 4: user model bids on which experiments run
body: In --allocation market with --taste-mode model, the user model (agent user_model) now bids on every gated design next to proposer/scout/contrarian/critic: P = prior log-odds shifted by the D1 taste score x learned taste weight. Advisory: it moves the consensus P but adds no supporting stake, never asks for GPU time, and is settled by log score, so its influence is earned. Off with --no-user-model-bids (ResearchConfig.user_model_bids). R0 and E5 (taste_mode none) are unchanged. Files: research/market.py (user_model_p, Market.bid_user_model, USER_MODEL), research/loop.py _place_bids, cli.py, docs/trail-and-gpu-market.md section 3. Nathan: small edit in loop.py _place_bids after your parallel-evals commit; all 840 tests pass.
